why: HP 38 = 8 at Rogue level 1, plus 5 fixed HP at each later level, plus Constitution modifier +2 at all five levels (Chapter 2, Leveling Up and Fixed Hit Points by Class).
AC 16 = Studded Leather 12 + Dexterity modifier +4 (Chapter 6, Armor table).
Saving throw proficiency is Dexterity and Intelligence; add proficiency bonus +3 to those ability modifiers (Chapter 3, Core Rogue Traits; Proficiency Bonus table).

Skills use their ability modifiers and +3 proficiency for the four Rogue picks and Criminal's Sleight of Hand and Stealth; Expertise adds proficiency twice to Sleight of Hand and Stealth (Chapter 3, Core Rogue Traits and Level 1: Expertise; Chapter 2, Criminal background).
Initiative is Dexterity modifier +4 plus the Alert feat's proficiency bonus +3 (Chapter 1, Initiative; Chapter 5, Alert feat).
Sneak Attack can be used once per turn (Chapter 3, Rogue, Level 1: Sneak Attack).

Attacks: the ability modifier (Strength for melee, Dexterity for ranged, either for Finesse) plus the Proficiency Bonus with a weapon the class is trained in; damage adds the same modifier. Checked by hand against the weapon table and each class's weapon training.
